summary: The Verge's guide lists the 2023 domestic holiday shipping deadlines for UPS, FedEx, USPS and major retailers (Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, Target) so gifts arrive by Christmas. It gives final ship dates by service level, plus same-day, pickup and fast-delivery options through Christmas Eve, with notes on minimums, memberships and third-party seller delays.
one_line: A 2023 guide to the last days to ship holiday gifts via UPS, FedEx, USPS, Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart and Target.
key_facts: UPS Next Day Air must ship by Thursday, December 21st, to arrive by Friday, December 22nd.
UPS 2nd Day Air's last ship date is December 20th, and UPS 3 Day Select's is December 19th.

FedEx SameDay can get a package there by Friday, December 22nd, the last day FedEx can guarantee arrival by Christmas; FedEx 2Day and 2Day A.M. must ship by December 20th and Express Saver by December 19th.
USPS Priority Mail Express and Priority Mail must ship by December 21st; Priority Mail packages can be delivered by December 23rd.
USPS First-Class Mail and USPS Ground Advantage must be sent by Wednesday, December 20th.

Amazon Prime offers Same-Day Delivery on certain items through December 24th in eligible ZIP codes, with a location-based minimum (over $25 in LA); One-Day Delivery runs through December 23rd and Two-Day through December 22nd.

Best Buy's free shipping cutoff for arrival by December 23rd is December 21st at 11:30AM ET; non-members need a $35 order threshold, while My Best Buy Plus and Total members get free two-day shipping with no minimum.
Best Buy offers free same-day delivery on orders placed December 23rd or 24th by 12PM local time (delivered by 7PM), and in-store pickup for online orders placed by 5PM local time on Christmas Eve.
Walmart orders over $35 ship free in two days if placed by 2PM local time on December 21st; Walmart Plus members get free next-day and two-day shipping with no minimum.
Walmart offers delivery in under two hours on Christmas Eve for a $10 Express Delivery fee if ordered by 12PM local time, and Walmart Plus members get one free Express Delivery in December.
Target offers same-day delivery and in-store pickup for orders placed by 6PM local time on Christmas Eve, though it advises ordering by December 23rd to be safe.
Target's Shipt service can deliver within an hour on Christmas Eve for orders before 4PM local time; an annual Shipt subscription costs $99 a year and was going for half off.
Target RedCard holders get free two-day shipping on many items, and many orders over $35 qualify even without a RedCard.
Items sold by third-party sellers at Amazon, Walmart and Target can have longer lead times.
